installation.description: The installation the backup is of.

role.description: The role that ran it: restore.

reason.description: A short word for why a restore failed; absent otherwise.

unverified.description: Whether the restore went ahead without the sealed audit record of its backup (an operator passed allowUnverified). Absent when the backup was verified.

verification.description: Why an unverified restore was not verified: unattested (no record of the backup), mismatch (the record disagrees with what was fetched), unsealed (the record's hour is not sealed yet), unavailable (the trail could not be asked, or no verification is configured). Absent when the backup was verified.

by.description: Who asked, in their own words: the caller declares it, and nothing verifies it.

modules.description: How many modules the restore wrote.
